lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Pennsylvania businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Pennsylvania has a major city at each end, a band of mid-sized cities across the south and east, and a wide rural middle. Philadelphia looks toward the East Coast and Pittsburgh toward the Midwest, and we plan campaigns for each region on its own terms.

sections.heading: Two anchor cities, a long way apart
paragraphs: Philadelphia sits in the southeast corner on the Delaware River, part of the corridor that runs from New York to Washington. Its economy is built on hospitals, universities, pharmaceutical and life science companies, finance and law, and its suburbs in Montgomery, Bucks, Chester and Delaware counties are among the wealthiest parts of the state.

Pittsburgh, at the western end, rebuilt itself after the decline of steel. Health systems and universities are now its largest employers, and research in robotics, software and medicine has created a strong technology community. The two cities are several hours apart by road, support different teams and rarely share customers.

sections.heading: The places in between
paragraphs: Harrisburg is the capital, with state government and the associations and contractors that surround it, and nearby Hershey draws families to its chocolate attractions and theme park. The Lehigh Valley, around Allentown and Bethlehem, has become a major warehousing and distribution area because of its reach into New York and New Jersey. Lancaster County combines productive farms with a large visitor trade. The Poconos are a resort region for skiing, lakes and weekend trips, Scranton and Wilkes-Barre anchor the northeast, Erie faces the lake, and State College revolves around Penn State.

Natural gas drilling has brought activity to the northern tier and the southwest, and manufacturing remains important across the state, from food and snack producers around York and Hanover to metals, glass and machinery.

sections.heading: Local search in a state of boroughs and townships
paragraphs: Pennsylvania is divided into a very large number of small municipalities, and residents identify with their borough, township or school district. Someone in the Philadelphia suburbs is more likely to search for a plumber in Doylestown, Media or West Chester than in the city, and the same is true of Cranberry or Mt. Lebanon near Pittsburgh. One page for a metro area rarely matches how people look.

Housing is old in much of the state, including rowhouses, stone farmhouses and mill-town homes, and that creates steady work for roofers, masons, heating firms and remodelers. Winters bring snow and ice, and oil and gas heat are both common.
bullets: Area pages for the towns you really serve, with relevant detail on each.
A business profile with an accurate service area and a steady flow of reviews.
Campaigns split by region so western and eastern results are never blended.
Service content written for older homes and local building types.
Tracking of calls and forms back to the town and keyword.

sections.heading: Visitors and the seasonal calendar
paragraphs: Tourism runs year round but shifts by region: historic sites in Philadelphia and Gettysburg, Lancaster farm country, autumn leaves in the mountains, ski slopes in winter. College towns follow the academic calendar and football weekends. Summer empties the Philadelphia area on weekends as residents head to the New Jersey shore. We plan content and budgets around the pattern that affects your trade.

presence: TDM works with Pennsylvania businesses remotely. We do not have an office in the state. We hold meetings by video call and share plans and reports online.

faqs.q: Does TDM have an office in Pennsylvania?
faqs.a: No. We work with Pennsylvania businesses remotely, with video calls and regular written reporting.

faqs.q: Should Philadelphia and Pittsburgh be separate campaigns?
faqs.a: Yes. They are different markets with different suburbs, competitors and costs. Separate campaigns, pages and budgets let you see what each one returns.

faqs.q: How do I appear in searches for nearby boroughs and townships?
faqs.a: Add useful pages for the municipalities you serve, set the service area in your business profile, and ask customers in those places for reviews that mention the work done.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to work with a marketing agency in Pennsylvania?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on scope, such as channels, regions and content. We give a quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How long will it take to see results from a campaign?
faqs.a: It depends on your requirements and brief and on your starting position. The timeline is set out and agreed in the plan.
